if_you_cut_one_page: Page 2: it is a series pitch with a slogan, delays the factory, and nothing later depends on it; fold one plain sentence into page 1.
notes: Cast bars, strips with file paths and character adjectives in brackets read as staging and should be kept off the reader's page. The method is credible; the missing piece is time and money per role, and who signs off when an agent is wrong beyond the editor. I would not hand it to a client until page 8 carries consequences and page 10 carries hours.
